Method of Attack: Downloading and executing arbitrary files on the system via update commands
Using commands --update, --download, and --updateRollback to download and/or execute payloads remotely
Executing arbitrary binary in the context of the current user
Discoverer: Mr. Un1k0d34 of the RingZer0 Team
Attack Vector: Using update commands in vulnerable applications relying on Squirrel project and NuGet package manager
Remote payload download and execution via crafted URLs
